title: The Consequences of Narrow Framing for Risk Taking: A Stress Test of Myopic Loss Aversion
authors: Rene Schwaiger; Markus Strucks; Stefan Zeisberger
eligible_reason: Large-scale replication experiment of Gneezy-Potters myopic loss aversion with randomized high/low evaluation-frequency treatments across six design versions. Treatment is randomized between subjects; no staggered adoption design. Main regressions are fractional-logit (quasibinomial glm) on treatment and treatment x version.
design_notes: Analysis_osf.R: glm(inv/100 ~ treatment + female + investor + finriskwill + statknow + innsbruck, family = quasibinomial) by version; the 'difference-in-difference MLA effect' in the text compares treatment effects across versions, not over calendar time.
data_files_note: Experimental data from three waves shipped.
